verdict.line: You lose trades level 1-5 to Volibear's Q stun chains, but you win the matchup overall at 56.1% over 132 games once your health stacking comes online.

brief.thesis: Volibear owns the early lane and solo-kill potential because Thundering Smash (Q, 300 range) locks you down into free autos and Sky Splitter (E, 1200 range) pokes you for free, but Sion's Enrage (E) permanent max-health gain and Cannibalism (R) leech let him out-scale that early pressure, which is why the measured head-to-head still favors Sion at 56.1% despite OP.GG rating the lane and solo-kill edge to Volibear.

theirWindow.what: He dashes in with Q to stun you then follows with double-cast W (Frenzied Maul) for the bonus damage and heal. Don't contest minions in melee range when his Q is off cooldown before you have W (Death's Caress) shield up.

yourWindow.what: Pop R (Cannibalism) and hold Enrage autos through the fight. His only sustain is the second W cast heal, so a drawn-out trade with your leech active swings in your favor.

start.why: Picked in 57.6% of wins over 92 games; the passive damage reduction on the first hit from each enemy directly blunts Volibear's poke autos and Q-into-auto combo before you have any real itemization.

boots.why: Taken in 52.7% of wins over 74 games; tenacity shortens the Q stun duration so you spend less time eating free autos and W marks during his all-in window.

core.why: First item on the 55.6%-winrate path; the health and regen directly counter the chip damage from Sky Splitter pokes and sustained autos.
Second item on that path; more bonus health that simultaneously buffs your Enrage attack damage, converting his inability to burst you late into your damage.
Closes the 55.6%-over-9-games path; stacking resistances caps out his mixed physical/magic damage once his passive starts adding bonus magic damage to autos.

situational.when: he is building into pure auto-attack damage and you need the grievous wounds to shut down his W self-heal
you want faster health stacking to scale your Enrage damage before his power spikes land
you are getting bullied by his on-hit poke before level 6 and need a cheap armor/antiheal piece early
the lane goes even and you want more wave clear and poke to punish his melee range during trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off the same extended melee trades Sion wants, healing you and permanently growing your health pool, which pairs directly with Enrage scaling and offsets Volibear's early poke advantage.

summoners.why: Run in 84.3% of games at 55.3% winrate; Flash dodges the Thundering Smash gap-close or his Stormbringer R landing, while Teleport lets you reset the wave safely during the levels 1-5 window where he has the kill pressure.

playing.title: Hold W for his Q engage
playing.detail: Raise Death's Caress (W) right as he closes with Thundering Smash so the shield absorbs the stun-into-autos damage instead of your health bar.

playing.title: Don't duel before level 6
playing.detail: His Q stun plus double-cast Frenzied Maul can chunk you for a big trade before Cannibalism (R) gives you sustain to answer it.

playing.title: Spend Enrage health carefully
playing.detail: Enrage autos cost health on top of what his on-hit W mark is already dealing, so only hold it active when you're winning the exchange.

playing.title: Pop R to flip extended fights
playing.detail: Once R is up, commit to longer trades since his only sustain is the second W cast heal and your leech outlasts it.

playing.title: Respect Sky Splitter range
playing.detail: His E is a 1200-range skillshot that slows and shields him if he's caught in it; don't facecheck brush or walk predictable lines pre-6.

playing.title: Farm kills for permanent health
playing.detail: Every unit killed while Enrage is active adds to your max health permanently, so prioritize safe caster/cannon kills to compound your scaling.

playing.title: Build into his damage profile
playing.detail: Hollow Radiance and Unending Despair both convert bonus health into tankiness and Enrage damage, directly answering his mixed-damage passive.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Volibear duing early game. Avoid his (E) used from out of sight.
